selection_history: The whole-pool OOD decision extension showed directional OBELiX ranking improvement before this design was written. Therefore this hard-OOD analysis is explicitly exploratory and cannot independently confirm that edge. The subset rule, three-edge family, controls, endpoints, and gates were locked before computing any hard-OOD result.
question: Is knowledge-borrowing decision utility concentrated among candidates compositionally farthest from all target-domain compositions available before the held-out campaign or fold?

distance.representation: normalized elemental-fraction vector in atomic-number column order
distance.metric: minimum L1 distance to any target-domain training-reference composition
distance.reference_scope: all eligible target-domain compositions available outside the held-out pool, not the repeated n=30 subset
distance.hard_ood_rule: Within each held-out pool, select exactly ceil(0.40*N) candidates after sorting distance descending and material_key ascending.

feasibility_amendment.change: The locked hard-OOD fraction was increased from 0.25 to 0.40 while retaining the farthest-first rule.
feasibility_amendment.reason: The first execution stopped before computing any decision metric because the smallest BIRDSHOT held-out pool yielded only five candidates at the 0.25 fraction, below the locked minimum of eight. The 0.40 fraction yields at least eight candidates in every pool.
feasibility_amendment.outcome_information_seen: Candidate counts and composition distances only; no target ranking, first-hit, enrichment, regret, effect, interval, or p-value was computed or inspected.

decision_endpoint.primary_effect: baseline minus augmented fraction of the hard-OOD pool screened before the first true top-5-percent hit

inference.multiplicity: Holm across exactly the three named composition-hard-OOD edges

improvement_gates: mean fraction-to-first-hit reduced by at least 25% relative to baseline
neither named control passes the same unadjusted core gates
claim_guard: Even a passing result is hypothesis-generating because the hard-OOD question followed inspection of the whole-pool OOD result. Independent confirmation requires a new dataset or prospectively held-out campaign.
